title: Permission checks, a toy hypervisor, and resource limits
brief: Decide Unix file access from mode bits, trap and emulate privileged guest instructions, and limit a real child process with setrlimit.
hints: Pick the class first: owner if uid matches, else group if the file's group is in gids, else other. Shift the mode right by 6, 3, or 0 and mask with 7. Then test (bits & want) == want.
Root skips the class lookup. Read and write always pass. Execute passes only if (mode & 0o111) is non-zero, or the target is a directory.
Deleting a file needs write and execute on the directory, not on the file. The sticky bit is mode & 0o1000. When it is set, only root, the directory's owner, or the file's owner may delete.
In run_vm, wrap hw_execute in try/except PrivilegeTrap and call emulate_privileged in the except branch. Count each path. The emulator must add 1 to vm.pc, because the hardware did not.
In run_limited the child runs setrlimit, then func(), and always ends in os._exit inside try/finally. The parent polls os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG) and sends SIGKILL after the timeout.
os.WIFSIGNALED(status) tells you a signal ended the process, and os.WTERMSIG(status) gives its number. Otherwise os.WEXITSTATUS(status) is the exit code.
